title: Understanding the Problem
text: We are adding random noise to the height and weight columns but not to the BMI column. The noise is drawn from a Normal distribution with mean $$0$$ and variance $$2$$.

title: Effect of Noise on Parameters
text: Consider how adding noise to the height and weight columns might affect the parameters of the models. The BMI column remains unchanged.

title: Bootstrapped Confidence Intervals
text: Bootstrapped confidence intervals are used to estimate the uncertainty of model parameters. Consider whether the added noise affects these intervals.
